question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is, **'prioritise**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prioritise** means **giving more attention and importance**.

 
 
• Example - ***Sam prioritises his work over his health***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, If we need to be
